title: HTML and Markdown exports leave equations out
symptom: to_html, to_html_fragment and to_markdown (Rust, Python) and oxoffice docx convert -t html or -t md drop every OfficeMath equation with no diagnostic: the text around it stays, the equation is gone
workaround: convert the equations yourself and place them: Rust paragraph.equations() and, for each inline equation (or each equation of a display group), equation_to_mathml or equation_to_latex on MathArgument::new(equation.expressions.clone()); Python paragraph.equations() then equation.to_mathml() or equation.to_latex(); none through the CLI
